Hi everyone, I'm Dana Reid. I coach the state junior team, and on Saturday I'm picking your interschool squad. So let me tell you what I'm looking for. I don't only want the surfer who does the biggest aerial. I want surfers who are consistent, surfers who catch good waves heat after heat. The best surfer is often the one that makes the fewest mistakes. I also look for style. A surfer with style is a surfer who makes hard things look easy. And I want to see your strength, but also your weakness. Everybody has one. The surfers that I pick are the ones who know their weakness and work on it. Last thing: a team needs people who help each other. So on Saturday, cheer for your mates. I'm watching that too.

Hey, Renato, it's Ollie. So, I'm writing the profiles for the newsletter, because I can't surf, and Kai said I'm the guy who talks the most. I need your profile by tonight. Can you answer three things? First, what's the board that you're using on Saturday? Everybody wants to know. Second, what's the wave that you love most in Brazil? And third, who's the surfer who inspires you? And don't say Medina, everybody says Medina. Oh, and I already wrote one line: Renato is the new member who saved my life. Too much? Maybe too much. Okay, send me your answers. Cheers, mate.
